messages:
ella: Noticing weird jumps in the latency dashboard for /v1/complete — p50 steady, p95 and p99 bounce around based on the dashboard time window. screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/heatmap.png

matt: Which window sizes? rolling 5m vs 1h?

ella: 5m shows a clear spike, 1h smooths it out. Concerned it's an aggregation artifact after the routing-policy tweak yesterday.

shreya: Could be sample-origin mixing (gateway vs backend). Are we including queue_time in the server-side metric?

ella: The metric is service_time_ms which should exclude external queue. Query used by dashboard: `approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.95)` on series `service_time_ms`.

matt: If some requests are routed to fallback variants with higher tail, a 5m window with few samples can flip p95 easily. We saw similar when adaptive routing weights shifted during the rollout.

ella: I dug into route tags — the rollouts service changed fallback weight from 0.05 -> 0.2 at 15:14 UTC (infra-bot reported).

infra-bot: rollout/route-weight-change: service=complete route=latency-fallback old=0.05 new=0.2 user=matt at=2025-03-12T15:14:02Z

shreya: Can you share a short sample breakdown by `route_variant` and `client_tag`? Small sample counts will make the percentile estimator unstable.

ella: Quick export was: `p95 overall = 230ms (n=120), p95 primary=210ms (n=100), p95 fallback=680ms (n=12)` — fallback has tiny n but huge p95.

matt: There it is. Dashboard shows merged percentiles without annotating sample counts per variant. UX asks for a sample-count badge per series.

shreya: Two problems: (1) the console's merge strategy uses weighted rollup without showing subgroup counts, (2) our approx_percentile implementation has poor error bounds for n < 50.

ella: Proposal: show a small `#samples` pill next to each percentile line and gray-out percentiles where n < 30 with a tooltip ("low sample power").

matt: Agreed. Also add an optional toggle: "split by route_variant" so teams can quickly see primary vs fallback tails.

shreya: As a short-term fix, we can change the tooltip for p95 to display the subgroup counts (client vs backend) from rollup metadata. Long term: switch to t-digest with deterministic merge keys for percentiles across rollups.

ella: Filed: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGPLAT-1421 — includes mockups for sample pill and split toggle.

matt: I'll open PR for the pill + tooltip (UI) and add a query param to the API to return `sample_counts_by_tag`.

shreya: Also adding a small note to the rollout runbook: when changing fallback weight, expect p95 churn until sample count stabilizes.

ella: Nice. For visibility, can we annotate the chart with the rollout event (infra-bot)? makes postmortems easier.

infra-bot: noted — adding event annotations for rollout.* and deploy.* to latency dashboards in next deploy.

matt: Cool. Next steps: PR #2761 for UI, API change in #2762, ENGPLAT-1421 tracks follow-ups. Will monitor p95 for next 6 hours. :thumbsup:
